name: thumbgenius-renderer
description: Remotion compositions for the ThumbGenius video worker
comment: Every version here is pinned EXACTLY, not caret-ranged, and the Docker build runs `npm install` with no lockfile — so a range would resolve fresh at build time and could differ from what was tested. Concretely: 4.0.512 of @remotion/cli depends on @remotion/studio@4.0.512, which was never published, and a caret range floats into it and kills the build.
